basis: Owner instructed using Taobao rules on 2026-10-31. Taobao seller agreement section 3.3.2 prohibits pornographic, violent, gambling and terror content, and 3.3.3 excludes prohibited/restricted goods. Current Taobao China App Store listing is 13+. GOStore has seller-provided product content and product promotions, but no chat, social feed, contests, gambling or unrestricted in-app browser. Infrequent alcohol references and mature/suggestive themes are conservatively declared for the broad shopping catalog, rather than assuming those references are filtered. This is a policy-based declaration, not an exhaustive catalog audit; review it if the catalog or features change.
